text: hello yes this is his nan I've got little Reggie stopping with me tonight his mum's on nights so it's just me and him and honestly I'm dead on my feet now he's three and he's had this cough since yesterday just a little one nothing bad really a little tickly cough every so often and his nose is running like a tap or then it's all blocked up and he's sneezing all over the place bless him I've gone through a whole box of tissues I've been up and down them stairs I don't know how many times he keeps waking up all snuffly and wanting his nan his breathing is fine though I want to say that I've sat and watched him and it's just normal breathing nothing funny going on with it not working hard or anything it's just the nose and the sneezing and the bit of cough I just wanted to check is there anything I should be doing for him overnight or do I just let him get on with it because I'm that tired I can't think straight anymore sorry it's a long one
